description: This file defines a Repository class providing data access methods for a task management backend system. It uses SQLAlchemy to connect to a database and includes methods for managing task statuses, users, tasks, and generating dashboard summaries.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: A thin repository class that provides database access methods for task statuses, users, tasks, and dashboard summaries.

methods.name: __init__(self, engine: Engine)
methods.description: Initializes the Repository with a SQLAlchemy Engine instance for database connections.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_statuses(self)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all task statuses from the database.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_status(self, status_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task status by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_status(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new task status with the provided payload.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_status(self, status_id: int, patch: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing task status specified by ID with provided changes.

methods.name: bool delete_status(self, status_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task status by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_users(self)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific user by ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_user(self, user_id: int, patch: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing user specified by ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tasks( self, status_id: Optional[int] = None, assignee_id: Optional[int] = None, due_date: Optional[date] = None, due_before: Optional[date] = None, limit: int = 200, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks, optionally filtered by status, assignee, and due date.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task(self, task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a task by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new task with provided details.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(self, task_id: int, patch: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates details of an existing task by ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] dashboard_summary(self, upcoming_limit: int = 5)
methods.description: Provides a summary including total tasks, count by status, and upcoming deadlines.
